column13: Outdoors: Wasson Peak, Seven Falls, Mt Lemmon (may have snow). Food: UNESCO City of Gastronomy. Museums: Desert Museum, Pima Air & Space, but not a big city. Price: cheapest. Getting there: 7-8h drive each way plus her flight. Safety: US, low risk.

Outdoors: one big hike (La Malinche); Ajusco dropped on safety grounds. Food and museums are world-class. Price: $3.5k midpoint. Getting there: 3h45 nonstop for him, 7.8h with 1 stop for her. Safety: Level 2; avoid taxis.

Outdoors: guided Sierra Norte 10-mile day plus Hierve el Agua. Food: elite. Museums: Santo Domingo museum, Monte Alban; a mid-size city. Getting there: 2 stops for him, 1 stop for her. Safety: Level 2; blockades.
Outdoors: Ryan Mtn, Lost Palms Oasis, San Jacinto via the tram. Food: decent. Museums: Palm Springs Art Museum, Sunnylands. Getting there: 2.5-3h drive plus her 11.9h flight. Safety: very low risk.
Outdoors: Caminito del Rey (short, closed Jan 11-19), Los Cahorros, Alpujarras. Food: tapas. Museums: Alhambra, Alcazar, Picasso. Getting there: about 18-19h each. Safety: petty theft only.
Outdoors: Path of the Gods; Vesuvius is now a short guided out-and-back. Food: pizza capital. Museums: MANN, Pompeii, Herculaneum. Getting there: 15h / 11h, 6-9h time shift. Safety: snatch theft.
Outdoors: moderate day hikes only. Food and museums: excellent. Price: cheapest of Europe. Getting there: 17.7h / 11.9h. Safety: Level 1; pickpockets.

Outdoors: Yangmingshan, Teapot Mtn; Taroko's main trails closed. Food: elite. Museums: National Palace Museum. Getting there: 14.7h nonstop for him, about 23h for her, 16h shift. Safety: Level 1, very safe. (Safety not researched in depth.)
Outdoors: El Yunque hikes are short. Food: good. Museums: Old San Juan forts, art museum. Getting there: about 11-13h with 1 stop each. Safety: car break-ins, outages.

Outdoors: Lantau Peak, MacLehose, Dragon's Back. Food: elite. Museums: M+, Palace Museum. Price: high because of her $1,923 fare. Getting there: 16h / 22h, 16h shift. Safety: low crime, but national security law and device-password legal risk.
Outdoors: best in set (volcano park, Mauna Kea). Museums: little city. Price: $5k midpoint. Getting there: 5h50 nonstop / 12.4h. Safety: natural hazards and break-ins.
Outdoors: PR1 and levadas, but weather closures happen in winter. Museums: Funchal is small. Getting there: about 22-24h / 17h. Safety: very low crime; trail hazards.
Outdoors: boat days and Sierra de la Laguna. Getting there: 2h30 nonstop for him, 2 stops for her. Safety: Level 2 (not researched in depth).
Outdoors: Teide (permit), Anaga, Masca. Museums: La Laguna only. Getting there: 18h / 21h. Safety: peaceful protests; hiking rescues.
Easiest to reach (3h nonstop / 7.4h), but Jalisco is Level 3 and it's beach-first.
Outdoors: Haleakala, Pipiwai, Waihe'e. Price: priciest. Museums: thin.
